instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Start, update or end the one Live Activity board for running work", and give it update_id; board_key; items; and the activities and devices you read from your own records.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:send-live-activity-update and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: retired_activity_ids are the tokens to forget, started_at is when a start was sent (pass it back as last_start_at). The tool keeps nothing.
